-- Full computation: predict toy sales for Dec 5-8, 2018 using linear regression,
-- compute 5-day symmetric moving averages, and sum them
WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales,
        CAST(DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - DATE('2017-01-01') as days_since_start
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, days_since_start) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, days_since_start) as intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
dates AS (
    SELECT DATE('2018-12-03') as target_date
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-04')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-05')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-06')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-07')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-08')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-09')
    UNION ALL SELECT DATE('2018-12-10')
),
predicted AS (
    SELECT 
        d.target_date,
        r.slope * (d.target_date - DATE('2017-01-01')) + r.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM dates d, regression r
),
moving_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        p.target_date,
        AVG(p2.predicted_sales) as moving_avg_5day
    FROM predicted p
    JOIN predicted p2 ON p2.target_date BETWEEN p.target_date - INTERVAL '2' DAY AND p.target_date + INTERVAL '2' DAY
    WHERE p.target_date BETWEEN DATE('2018-12-05') AND DATE('2018-12-08')
    GROUP BY p.target_date
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5day) as sum_of_5day_moving_averages
FROM moving_averages

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS order_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
        SUM(order_total) AS total_spend,
        SUM(order_total) / 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        last_purchase,
        order_count,
        total_spend,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        CAST(date_diff('day', CAST(last_purchase AS TIMESTAMP), CAST('2018-08-29 15:00:37' AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS recency_days,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(last_purchase AS TIMESTAMP) DESC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_metrics
),
rfm_segmented AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        last_purchase,
        order_count,
        total_spend,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        recency_days,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_score,
        f_score + m_score AS fm_sum,
        CASE 
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scores
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order,
    ROUND(AVG(total_spend), 2) AS avg_total_spend,
    ROUND(AVG(order_count), 2) AS avg_order_count,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days
FROM rfm_segmented
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        SUM(op.payment_value) as order_total_payment
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(order_id) as num_orders,
        SUM(order_total_payment) / COUNT(order_id) as avg_payment_per_order,
        CASE 
            WHEN (CAST(MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE)) / 7.0 < 1.0 THEN 1.0
            ELSE ROUND((CAST(MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE) - CAST(MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DATE)) / 7.0, 2)
        END as lifespan_weeks
    FROM order_totals
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    num_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Now compute the average career span across all players with both dates
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(
    ROUND(CAST(ABS(date_part('year', age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE)))) AS DOUBLE), 2) 
    + ROUND(CAST(ABS(date_part('month', age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE)))) AS DOUBLE) / 12.0, 2)
    + ROUND(CAST(ABS(date_part('day', age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE)))) AS DOUBLE) / 365.0, 2)
  ), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM player
WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''

WITH career_stats AS (
  SELECT player_id,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) as total_g,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) as total_r,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) as total_h,
    SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) as total_hr
  FROM batting
  WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT player_id, total_g, total_r, total_h, total_hr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_g DESC) as g_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_r DESC) as r_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_h DESC) as h_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_hr DESC) as hr_rank
  FROM career_stats
),
top_players AS (
  SELECT player_id, total_g, total_r, total_h, total_hr,
    CASE WHEN g_rank = 1 THEN total_g ELSE NULL END as leader_g,
    CASE WHEN r_rank = 1 THEN total_r ELSE NULL END as leader_r,
    CASE WHEN h_rank = 1 THEN total_h ELSE NULL END as leader_h,
    CASE WHEN hr_rank = 1 THEN total_hr ELSE NULL END as leader_hr
  FROM ranked
  WHERE g_rank = 1 OR r_rank = 1 OR h_rank = 1 OR hr_rank = 1
)
SELECT p.name_given, tp.total_g, tp.total_r, tp.total_h, tp.total_hr
FROM top_players tp
JOIN player p ON tp.player_id = p.player_id

WITH abakan_routes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.departure_airport, f.arrival_airport
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
  WHERE dep.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR arr.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
),
route_coords AS (
  SELECT ar.departure_airport, ar.arrival_airport
  FROM abakan_routes ar
  JOIN airports_data dep ON ar.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON ar.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT *,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH '(' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 1)) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lon,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH ')' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 2)) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lat,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH '(' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 1)) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lon,
         TRY_CAST(TRIM(BOTH ')' FROM SPLIT_PART(CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',', 2)) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lat
  FROM route_coords
  JOIN airports_data dep ON route_coords.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON route_coords.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
)
SELECT departure_airport, arrival_airport,
       ROUND(6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
         POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
         COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
         POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
       )), 2) AS distance_km
FROM parsed
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH flight_coords AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    dep.city AS from_city,
    arr.city AS to_city,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS dep_lat,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), '(', ''), ')', ''), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
with_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    from_city,
    to_city,
    6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
      POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 360), 2) +
      COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) * POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 360), 2)
    )) AS distance
  FROM flight_coords
  WHERE dep_lat IS NOT NULL AND arr_lat IS NOT NULL
),
city_pair AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN from_city <= to_city THEN from_city ELSE to_city END AS city1,
    CASE WHEN from_city <= to_city THEN to_city ELSE from_city END AS city2,
    distance
  FROM with_distance
),
avg_distance AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    AVG(distance) AS avg_distance
  FROM city_pair
  GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_ranges AS (
  SELECT 
    city1,
    city2,
    avg_distance,
    CASE 
      WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-1999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-2999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-3999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-4999'
      WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-5999'
      ELSE '6000+'
    END AS distance_range
  FROM avg_distance
),
range_counts AS (
  SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) AS pair_count
  FROM with_ranges
  GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) AS fewest_pairs_count
FROM range_counts

-- Final result
WITH motorcycle_case_ids AS (
  SELECT CAST(case_id AS DOUBLE) as case_id FROM collisions WHERE motorcycle_collision = 1
),
mc_parties AS (
  SELECT 
    p.case_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet used%' THEN 'helmet_used'
      WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet not used%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet not used%' THEN 'helmet_not_used'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as helmet_status
  FROM parties p
  WHERE p.case_id IN (SELECT case_id FROM motorcycle_case_ids)
),
mc_collision_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    case_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN helmet_status = 'helmet_used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_helmet_used,
    MAX(CASE WHEN helmet_status = 'helmet_not_used' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_helmet_not_used
  FROM mc_parties
  GROUP BY case_id
),
helmet_used_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT case_id FROM mc_collision_groups WHERE has_helmet_used = 1
),
helmet_not_used_cases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT case_id FROM mc_collision_groups WHERE has_helmet_not_used = 1
)
SELECT 
  'helmet used' as helmet_usage_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) as total_collisions,
  SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) as motorcyclist_fatalities,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM collisions c
WHERE c.case_id IN (SELECT case_id FROM helmet_used_cases)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'helmet not used' as helmet_usage_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) as total_collisions,
  SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) as motorcyclist_fatalities,
  ROUND(1.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM collisions c
WHERE c.case_id IN (SELECT case_id FROM helmet_not_used_cases)

-- Check if any other year has a different top-2 combination
WITH yearly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS collision_year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    collision_year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collision_year ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM yearly_counts
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT collision_year, pcf_violation_category, cnt
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
),
year_combos AS (
  SELECT 
    collision_year,
    string_agg(pcf_violation_category, '|' ORDER BY pcf_violation_category) AS cause_combo
  FROM top2
  GROUP BY collision_year
)
SELECT * FROM year_combos ORDER BY collision_year

WITH yearly_speeding AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS speeding_cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE pcf_violation_category = 'speeding'
    AND SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4)
),
yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
  'speeding' AS pcf_violation_category,
  ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.year = '2011' THEN 100.0 * s.speeding_cnt / t.total_cnt END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.year = '2021' THEN 100.0 * s.speeding_cnt / t.total_cnt END),
  2) AS percentage_point_decrease
FROM yearly_speeding s
JOIN yearly_totals t ON s.year = t.year

SELECT w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m 
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = CAST(b.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = CAST(w1.id AS TEXT)
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = CAST(w2.id AS TEXT)
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship' 
  AND m.title_change = 0 
  AND m.duration = '00:43'
LIMIT 5

-- Final query with integer casts
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.over_id,
        CAST(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS INTEGER) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
over_bowler AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no, over_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id, bowler
),
over_with_bowler AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.innings_no, o.over_id, o.total_runs, ob.bowler
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN over_bowler ob ON o.match_id = ob.match_id AND o.innings_no = ob.innings_no AND o.over_id = ob.over_id AND ob.rn = 1
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_with_bowler
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_over_overs AS (
    SELECT owb.match_id, owb.innings_no, owb.over_id, owb.total_runs, owb.bowler
    FROM over_with_bowler owb
    JOIN max_runs_per_match mpm ON owb.match_id = mpm.match_id
    WHERE owb.total_runs = mpm.max_runs
),
bowler_max AS (
    SELECT bowler, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs_in_max_over
    FROM max_over_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, bmm.match_id, bmm.total_runs as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_max t
JOIN (
    SELECT bowler, total_runs, match_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id ASC) as rn
    FROM max_over_overs
) bmm ON t.bowler = bmm.bowler AND t.max_runs_in_max_over = bmm.total_runs AND bmm.rn = 1
JOIN player p ON t.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY t.max_runs_in_max_over DESC
LIMIT 3;

-- Final query: bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH bowler_runs AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, 
    COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN e.extra_runs ELSE 0 END), 0) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
    ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
  FROM wicket_taken w
  JOIN ball_by_ball b 
    ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bw.wickets > 0
ORDER BY (1.0 * br.total_runs / bw.wickets) ASC
LIMIT 1;

-- Step 2: Get the qualifying strikers and their total runs across all matches, then average
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker, bbb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs_in_match
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs_in_match > 50
),
striker_totals AS (
    SELECT smr.striker, SUM(smr.total_runs_in_match) as total_runs_all_matches
    FROM striker_match_runs smr
    WHERE smr.striker IN (SELECT striker FROM qualifying_strikers)
    GROUP BY smr.striker
)
SELECT AVG(1.0 * total_runs_all_matches) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_totals

-- Final query: distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match while playing for the losing team
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(CAST(bs.runs_scored AS INTEGER)) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name
FROM player_match_runs pmr
JOIN player_match pm ON pmr.player_id = pm.player_id AND pmr.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN match m ON pmr.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmr.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmr.total_runs >= 100
  AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name

WITH season5_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker AS player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    JOIN season5_matches s ON bbb.match_id = s.match_id
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN season5_matches s ON pm.match_id = s.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN season5_matches s ON wt.match_id = s.match_id
    GROUP BY player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       ROUND(1.0 * pr.total_runs / pm.matches_played, 2) AS avg_runs_per_match,
       ROUND(CASE WHEN pd.dismissals > 0 THEN 1.0 * pr.total_runs / pd.dismissals ELSE NULL END, 2) AS batting_average
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON pr.player_id = pd.player_id
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final query: Top 5 countries by average of players' individual average runs per match
WITH player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id) AS matches_played,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
player_avg_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        total_runs / matches_played AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_avg
)
SELECT 
    p.country_name,
    AVG(pam.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_avg
FROM player_avg_per_match pam
JOIN player p ON pam.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_avg DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final query: average of highest over totals across all matches
WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, 
           COALESCE(SUM(b.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored b
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e 
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = e.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, over_id, innings_no) as rn
    FROM over_totals
),
winner_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, total_runs
    FROM max_over_per_match
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_highest_over_runs
FROM winner_over

    delivered_orders,

city_aggregates AS (

    FROM city_aggregates
    ORDER BY sum_payments ASC

       AVG(sum_payments) OVER () as avg_total_payments,
       AVG(delivered_order_count) OVER () as avg_delivered_order_counts
FROM top5

WITH distinct_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
ordered_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
        LAG(geolocation_zip_code_prefix) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_zip,
        LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng
    FROM distinct_cities
),
with_distance AS (
    SELECT 
        prev_state,
        prev_city,
        prev_zip AS prev_zip_code_prefix,
        prev_lat,
        prev_lng,
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        6371 * ACOS(
            LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0,
                COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(prev_lng)) +
                SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat))
            ))
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM ordered_cities
    WHERE prev_state IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM with_distance
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

-- Full query: total rental hours by film category for cities starting with 'A' or containing '-'
SELECT c.name as category_name,
       SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 3600.0) as total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN customer cust ON r.customer_id = cust.customer_id
JOIN address addr ON cust.address_id = addr.address_id
JOIN city cit ON addr.city_id = cit.city_id
WHERE cit.city LIKE 'A%' OR cit.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1

-- There are 4 countries with > 4 customers. For median with even count, we need the average of the two middle values.
-- Let's use DuckDB's MEDIAN function
WITH qualifying_countries AS (
    SELECT c.Country
    FROM customers c
    GROUP BY c.Country
    HAVING COUNT(c.CustomerId) > 4
),
country_totals AS (
    SELECT i.BillingCountry, SUM(i.Total) as total_sales
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN qualifying_countries qc ON i.BillingCountry = qc.Country
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry
)

FROM country_totals;

-- Final query: find customer with highest average monthly change in payment amounts
-- Using absolute month-over-month changes in total monthly payments
WITH monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', payment_date) as month,
    SUM(amount) as monthly_total
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month,
    monthly_total,
    LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as prev_month_total
  FROM monthly_totals
),
changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    ABS(monthly_total - prev_month_total) as abs_change
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE prev_month_total IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  AVG(ch.abs_change) as avg_monthly_change
FROM changes ch
JOIN customer c ON ch.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1

    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id

      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999

qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q2020.cust_city
    FROM city_quarter_sales q2020
    JOIN city_quarter_sales q2019 ON q2020.cust_city = q2019.cust_city
    WHERE q2019.total_sales > 0
      AND 1.0 * (q2020.total_sales - q2019.total_sales) / q2019.total_sales >= 0.20

city_product_totals AS (

        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_product_sales

      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id

ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        total_product_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_product_sales DESC) AS tile
    FROM city_product_totals
),
top_products AS (

    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE tile = 1
),
city_total_sales AS (

        t.calendar_year,

    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year
),
city_product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN us_customers uc ON s.cust_id = uc.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON uc.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020) 
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year
),
product_quarter_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        cps.prod_id,
        cps.calendar_year,
        1.0 * cps.product_sales / cts.total_sales AS share
    FROM city_product_sales cps
    JOIN city_total_sales cts ON cps.calendar_year = cts.calendar_year
    JOIN top_products tp ON cps.prod_id = tp.prod_id
)
SELECT 
    prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) AS share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) AS share_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN share END) - MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN share END) AS share_change
FROM product_quarter_shares
GROUP BY prod_id
ORDER BY share_change DESC

WITH us_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, s.cust_id, s.time_id, s.amount_sold,
         c.cust_city, c.country_id
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999 
    AND c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.time_id IN (
      SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    )
),
city_sales AS (
  SELECT cust_city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020
  FROM us_sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  GROUP BY cust_city
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN amount_sold ELSE 0 END)
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT us.prod_id, us.amount_sold, us.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_id
  FROM us_sales us
  JOIN times t ON us.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE us.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(amount_sold) AS q_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
total_sales_by_quarter AS (
  SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(q_sales) AS total_q_sales
  FROM product_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT pq.prod_id, pq.calendar_quarter_id,
    pq.q_sales,
    t.total_q_sales,
    1.0 * pq.q_sales / t.total_q_sales * 100 AS share_pct
  FROM product_quarter_sales pq
  JOIN total_sales_by_quarter t ON pq.calendar_quarter_id = t.calendar_quarter_id
),
product_totals AS (
  SELECT prod_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM filtered_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS nt
  FROM product_totals
),
top20_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id FROM ranked_products WHERE nt = 1
),
share_changes AS (
  SELECT ps.prod_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END) AS share_2019,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) AS share_2020,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END) AS pct_point_change,
    ABS(MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN ps.share_pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN ps.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN ps.share_pct END)) AS abs_change
  FROM product_shares ps
  WHERE ps.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top20_products)
  GROUP BY ps.prod_id
)
SELECT sc.prod_id, p.prod_name, sc.share_2019, sc.share_2020, sc.pct_point_change, sc.abs_change
FROM share_changes sc
JOIN products p ON sc.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY sc.abs_change ASC
LIMIT 30

WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
        AND p.promo_total_id = 1
        AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
        AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number, s.prod_id
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2019 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_year = 2020 THEN total_sales END) as sales_2020
    FROM france_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_month_number
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        calendar_month_number,
        ((sales_2020 - sales_2019) * 1.0 / sales_2019 * sales_2020) + sales_2020 as projected_2021
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2019 != 0
),
projected_with_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        wg.calendar_month_number,
        wg.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_usd
    FROM with_growth wg
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' AND c.year = 2021 AND c.month = wg.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT 
    calendar_month_number,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_usd), 2) as avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projected_with_rate
GROUP BY calendar_month_number
ORDER BY calendar_month_number

-- Find the median of projected 2021 sales in USD, rounded to 2 decimal places
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_total
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    JOIN promotions pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND pr.promo_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        s2020.calendar_month_number,
        s2019.monthly_total as sales_2019,
        s2020.monthly_total as sales_2020,
        (((s2020.monthly_total - s2019.monthly_total) / s2019.monthly_total) * s2020.monthly_total) + s2020.monthly_total as projected_2021
    FROM france_sales s2020
    JOIN france_sales s2019 ON s2020.calendar_month_number = s2019.calendar_month_number
    WHERE s2020.calendar_year = 2020
      AND s2019.calendar_year = 2019
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.calendar_month_number,
        p.projected_2021 * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected p
    JOIN currency c ON p.calendar_month_number = c.month 
        AND 2021 = c.year 
        AND c.country = 'France'
)
SELECT ROUND(MEDIAN(projected_2021_usd), 2) as median_projected_sales_usd
FROM with_currency

-- Verify: check bucket boundaries for each bucket
WITH customer_profits AS (
    SELECT p.cust_id, 
           SUM(p.quantity_sold * (p.unit_price - p.unit_cost)) as total_profit
    FROM profits p
    JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON p.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND t.calendar_year = 2021
      AND t.calendar_month_number = 12
    GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
min_max AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_profit) as min_profit, MAX(total_profit) as max_profit
    FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT cp.cust_id, cp.total_profit,
           LEAST(CAST(FLOOR((cp.total_profit - mm.min_profit) / ((mm.max_profit - mm.min_profit) / 10.0)) + 1 AS INTEGER), 10) as bucket
    FROM customer_profits cp, min_max mm
)
SELECT bucket, 
       COUNT(*) as num_customers, 
       ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) as min_profit, 
       ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) as max_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT p.cust_id, SUM((p.unit_price - p.unit_cost) * p.quantity_sold) as total_profit
  FROM profits p
  JOIN customers c ON p.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND p.time_id >= '2021-12-01'
    AND p.time_id < '2022-01-01'
  GROUP BY p.cust_id
),
tiered AS (
  SELECT cust_id, total_profit,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) as tier
  FROM customer_profits
)
SELECT tier,
       COUNT(*) as num_customers_in_tier,
       ROUND(MAX(total_profit), 2) as highest_profit,
       ROUND(MIN(total_profit), 2) as lowest_profit
FROM tiered
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier

SELECT 
  insert_date,
  concat(upper(left(city_name, 1)), lower(substring(city_name from 2))) AS city_name
FROM cities
WHERE country_code_2 = 'cn'
  AND insert_date >= '2021-07-01'
  AND insert_date <= '2021-07-31'
  AND CAST(insert_date AS DATE) IN ('2021-07-12', '2021-07-13', '2021-07-19', '2021-07-20', '2021-07-21', '2021-07-22', '2021-07-23', '2021-07-24', '2021-07-25', '2021-07-26', '2021-07-27', '2021-07-28', '2021-07-29', '2021-07-30', '2021-07-31')
ORDER BY insert_date, city_name

WITH june_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) as rn
  FROM june_dates
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date, rn,
    insert_date - (rn || ' day')::INTERVAL as grp
  FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, grp,
    COUNT(*) as streak_length
  FROM grouped
  GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
max_per_country AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, streak_length,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY streak_length DESC) as rn
  FROM streaks
),
country_max AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, streak_length
  FROM max_per_country
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT country_code_2
FROM country_max
WHERE streak_length = (SELECT MAX(streak_length) FROM country_max)
ORDER BY country_code_2

WITH dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE country_code_2 = 'ir' 
    AND insert_date >= '2022-01-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-01-31'
),
consecutive AS (
  SELECT insert_date,
         insert_date - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS grp
  FROM dates
),
groups AS (
  SELECT grp, MIN(insert_date) AS start_date, MAX(insert_date) AS end_date, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM consecutive
  GROUP BY grp
),
longest AS (
  SELECT start_date, end_date
  FROM groups
  ORDER BY len DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'ir' AS country_code_2,
       l.start_date,
       l.end_date,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.capital = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS capital_proportion
FROM longest l
JOIN cities c ON c.country_code_2 = 'ir'
  AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) >= l.start_date AND CAST(c.insert_date AS DATE) <= l.end_date
GROUP BY l.start_date, l.end_date

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CASE 
      WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 'April'
      WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 5 THEN 'May'
      WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN 'June'
    END AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
  FROM cities
  WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023
    AND CAST(SUBSTR(insert_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5, 6)
  GROUP BY year, month
),
with_running_total AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    monthly_count,
    CAST(SUM(monthly_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS INTEGER) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_counts
),
with_prev_year AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    month,
    monthly_count,
    running_total,
    LAG(monthly_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_monthly_count,
    LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
  FROM with_running_total
)
SELECT 
  year,
  month,
  monthly_count,
  running_total,
  ROUND(1.0 * (monthly_count - prev_monthly_count) / prev_monthly_count * 100, 2) AS monthly_growth_pct,
  ROUND(1.0 * (running_total - prev_running_total) / prev_running_total * 100, 2) AS running_total_growth_pct
FROM with_prev_year
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, 
  CASE month WHEN 'April' THEN 1 WHEN 'May' THEN 2 WHEN 'June' THEN 3 END

WITH 
pizza_toppings_list AS (
    SELECT pizza_id, 
           trim(unnest(string_split(toppings, ','))) AS topping_id
    FROM pizza_recipes
),
pizza_standard AS (
    SELECT p.pizza_id,
           list(t.topping_name) AS standard_names,
           list(t.topping_id) AS standard_ids
    FROM pizza_toppings_list p
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(p.topping_id AS INTEGER)
    GROUP BY p.pizza_id
),
numbered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id, order_time) AS row_id,
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        pizza_id,
        exclusions,
        extras,
        order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        n.row_id,
        n.order_id,
        n.customer_id,
        n.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        n.order_time,
        ps.standard_names,
        n.exclusions AS excl_str,
        n.extras AS extras_str
    FROM numbered_orders n
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_standard ps ON ps.pizza_id = n.pizza_id
),
excl_expanded AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           trim(unnest(string_split(excl_str, ','))) AS excl_topping_id
    FROM combined
    WHERE excl_str IS NOT NULL AND excl_str != ''
),
extras_expanded AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           trim(unnest(string_split(extras_str, ','))) AS extra_topping_id
    FROM combined
    WHERE extras_str IS NOT NULL AND extras_str != ''
),
ingredient_counts AS (
    SELECT c.row_id,
           t.topping_name,
           1 AS count_val
    FROM combined c
    JOIN pizza_toppings_list ptl ON ptl.pizza_id = c.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(ptl.topping_id AS INTEGER)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM excl_expanded ee 
        WHERE ee.row_id = c.row_id 
        AND ee.excl_topping_id = ptl.topping_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.row_id,
           t.topping_name,
           1 AS count_val
    FROM combined c
    JOIN extras_expanded ee ON ee.row_id = c.row_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(ee.extra_topping_id AS INTEGER)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           topping_name,
           SUM(count_val) AS total_count
    FROM ingredient_counts
    GROUP BY row_id, topping_name
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT row_id,
           topping_name,
           total_count,
           CASE WHEN total_count > 1 THEN '2x ' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END AS formatted_name
    FROM counts
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        c.row_id,
        c.order_id,
        c.customer_id,
        c.pizza_name,
        c.order_time,
        string_agg(f.formatted_name, ', ' ORDER BY 
            CASE WHEN f.total_count > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
            f.topping_name
        ) AS ingredients
    FROM combined c
    LEFT JOIN formatted f ON f.row_id = c.row_id
    GROUP BY c.row_id, c.order_id, c.customer_id, c.pizza_name, c.order_time
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients AS ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id

-- Build the base: count of each pizza_id in delivered orders
WITH delivered_order_ids AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM pizza_clean_runner_orders
    WHERE cancellation IS NULL OR cancellation = ''
),
pizza_counts AS (
    SELECT co.pizza_id, COUNT(*) as pizza_count
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
    WHERE co.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_order_ids)
    GROUP BY co.pizza_id
),
topping_expanded AS (
    SELECT pc.pizza_id, pc.pizza_count, 
           CAST(UNNEST(string_split(trim(pr.toppings), ',')) AS BIGINT) as topping_id
    FROM pizza_counts pc
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pc.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
-- Count each topping from base pizzas
base_topping_counts AS (
    SELECT topping_id, SUM(pizza_count) as quantity
    FROM topping_expanded
    GROUP BY topping_id
),
-- Add extras from delivered orders
extras_topping_counts AS (
    SELECT pge.extras as topping_id, SUM(pge.extras_count) as quantity
    FROM pizza_get_extras pge
    WHERE pge.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_order_ids)
    GROUP BY pge.extras
),
-- Combine base and extras
combined AS (
    SELECT topping_id, quantity FROM base_topping_counts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT topping_id, quantity FROM extras_topping_counts
)
SELECT pt.topping_name, SUM(c.quantity) as total_quantity
FROM combined c
JOIN pizza_toppings pt ON c.topping_id = pt.topping_id
GROUP BY pt.topping_name
ORDER BY pt.topping_name

WITH distinct_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT d.order_id, d.pizza_id, d.extras
    FROM distinct_orders d
    JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders r ON d.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.cancellation IS NULL OR r.cancellation = ''
    AND d.pizza_id IN (1, 2)
)
SELECT 
    SUM(
        CASE WHEN pizza_id = 1 THEN 12.0 
             WHEN pizza_id = 2 THEN 10.0 
        END
        + CASE 
            WHEN extras IS NULL OR extras = '' THEN 0
            ELSE 1 + LENGTH(extras) - LENGTH(REPLACE(extras, ',', ''))
          END
    ) AS total_income
FROM filtered_orders

-- Final query with all columns: customer_id, month, monthly_change, closing_balance (cumulative)
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month
  FROM customer_transactions
  ORDER BY month
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.month,
    COALESCE(mc.monthly_change, 0) as monthly_change
  FROM customer_months cm
  LEFT JOIN monthly_changes mc ON cm.customer_id = mc.customer_id AND cm.month = mc.month
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  month,
  monthly_change,
  SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as closing_balance
FROM combined
ORDER BY customer_id, month

-- Final query: find the difference between avg balance of highest positive-count month and lowest positive-count month
WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT '2020-01' as month UNION ALL SELECT '2020-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2020-04'
),
customer_month_combos AS (
    SELECT a.customer_id, m.month
    FROM all_customers a, all_months m
),
customer_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE substr(txn_date, 1, 7) IN ('2020-01', '2020-02', '2020-03', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month,
        COALESCE(cb.month_end_balance, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM customer_month_combos cm
    LEFT JOIN customer_balances cb ON cm.customer_id = cb.customer_id AND cm.month = cb.month
),
monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance,
        SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive_count
    FROM customer_month_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        avg_balance,
        positive_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC) as highest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC) as lowest_rank
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE highest_rank = 1) - 
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked_months WHERE lowest_rank = 1) as difference

-- Final: percentage of customers with growth rate > 5%
WITH monthly_nets AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) AS month_start
  FROM customer_transactions
),
all_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_start
  FROM all_customers c
  CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
filled_nets AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.month_start,
    COALESCE(mn.monthly_net, 0) AS monthly_net
  FROM customer_months cm
  LEFT JOIN monthly_nets mn 
    ON cm.customer_id = mn.customer_id AND cm.month_start = mn.month_start
),
with_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    monthly_net,
    SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_balance
  FROM filled_nets
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    monthly_net,
    closing_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
  FROM with_balances
),
most_recent AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month_start, monthly_net, closing_balance, rn
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
with_prior AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.customer_id,

    mr.closing_balance AS current_balance,
    COALESCE(prev.closing_balance, 0) AS prior_balance
  FROM most_recent mr
  LEFT JOIN ranked prev 
    ON mr.customer_id = prev.customer_id AND prev.rn = 2
),
growth_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN prior_balance = 0 THEN current_balance * 100.0
      ELSE (current_balance - prior_balance) * 100.0 / prior_balance

  FROM with_prior
)
SELECT

WITH monthly_dates AS (

customer_balances AS (

    FROM customer_transactions
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,

            CASE WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount 
                 ELSE -ct.txn_amount 
            END
        ), 0) as balance
    FROM customer_balances c
    CROSS JOIN monthly_dates m
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct 
        ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id 
        AND ct.txn_date::DATE <= m.month_date::DATE
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, m.month_date
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT month_date, SUM(COALESCE(balance, 0)) as total_balance
    FROM balances
    GROUP BY month_date
),
monthly_totals_capped AS (
    SELECT month_date, GREATEST(total_balance, 0) as total_balance
    FROM monthly_totals
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_date,
        total_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month_date) as rn
    FROM monthly_totals_capped
)

WITH daily_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
running_balance AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_net_change,
           SUM(daily_net_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
    FROM daily_net
),
all_first_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(txn_date)) as first_month
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_day AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as first_txn_date
    FROM daily_net
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
rolling_avg AS (
    SELECT rb.customer_id, rb.txn_date, rb.running_balance,
           AVG(rb2.running_balance) as rolling_30d_avg
    FROM running_balance rb
    JOIN running_balance rb2 
        ON rb.customer_id = rb2.customer_id 
        AND rb2.txn_date >= rb.txn_date - INTERVAL '29' DAY
        AND rb2.txn_date <= rb.txn_date
    GROUP BY rb.customer_id, rb.txn_date, rb.running_balance
),
with_first_day AS (
    SELECT ra.customer_id, ra.txn_date, ra.rolling_30d_avg,
           fd.first_txn_date,
           DATEDIFF('day', fd.first_txn_date, ra.txn_date) as days_since_first
    FROM rolling_avg ra
    JOIN first_day fd ON ra.customer_id = fd.customer_id
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
           GREATEST(0, rolling_30d_avg) as rolling_30d_avg_capped
    FROM with_first_day
    WHERE days_since_first >= 29
),
with_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, rolling_30d_avg_capped,
           DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) as month_date
    FROM qualified
),
excluded AS (
    SELECT wm.customer_id, wm.txn_date, wm.rolling_30d_avg_capped, wm.month_date
    FROM with_month wm
    JOIN all_first_month afm ON wm.customer_id = afm.customer_id
    WHERE wm.month_date != afm.first_month
),
max_per_customer_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_date,
           MAX(rolling_30d_avg_capped) as max_30d_avg
    FROM excluded
    GROUP BY customer_id, month_date
)
SELECT month_date, SUM(max_30d_avg) as total_max_30d_avg
FROM max_per_customer_month
GROUP BY month_date
ORDER BY month_date

WITH daily_changes AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END) as daily_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_date_ranges AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as min_date, MAX(txn_date) as max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT cdr.customer_id, 
    DATE_ADD(DATE(cdr.min_date), seq * INTERVAL '1' day) as cal_date
  FROM customer_date_ranges cdr,
  LATERAL (SELECT UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, DATE_DIFF('day', DATE(cdr.min_date), DATE(cdr.max_date)))) as seq)
),
daily_balances_raw AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.cal_date, 
    COALESCE(dc.daily_change, 0) as daily_change
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.cal_date = dc.txn_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
  SELECT customer_id, cal_date, daily_change,
    SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY cal_date) as running_balance
  FROM daily_balances_raw
),
clamped_balances AS (
  SELECT customer_id, cal_date,
    GREATEST(running_balance, 0) as daily_balance
  FROM cumulative_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date) as month_start,
    customer_id,
    MAX(daily_balance) as max_daily_balance
  FROM clamped_balances
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', cal_date), customer_id
)
SELECT 
  month_start as month,
  SUM(max_daily_balance) as monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start

-- Also let me double check the rounding for avg_inter_movie_duration - EXTRACT gives a float, ROUND should work
SELECT 
    name_id,

    total_duration

        SELECT dm.name_id, n.name, m.id as movie_id, m.date_published, m.duration, r.avg_rating, r.total_votes,

               CASE WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL

                    ELSE NULL 
               END as days_since_prev
        FROM director_movies

    SELECT 
        name_id,
        name,

    FROM bitcoin_transactions bt

    JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.txn_date = bp.market_date AND bt.ticker = bp.ticker
    WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
    GROUP BY bm.region, SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, -4)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) as price_rank,
        LAG(avg_purchase_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year) as prev_year_price
    FROM region_yearly
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        year,
        avg_purchase_price,
        price_rank,
        prev_year_price,
        MIN(year) OVER (PARTITION BY region) as first_year
    FROM ranked
)

    region,

    price_rank,

WITH converted AS (

      WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
      ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
    END AS numeric_volume,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(market_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 1, 2) AS DATE) AS sort_date

with_prev AS (

  FROM converted
)

  ticker,

  ROUND(100.0 * (numeric_volume - prev_volume) / prev_volume, 2) AS pct_change
FROM with_prev

),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM cohort
),
year_offsets AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(1, 20)) as year_num
),
check_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        y.year_num,
        CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(c.first_term_start AS DATE)) + y.year_num AS VARCHAR) || '-12-31' AS DATE) as check_date
    FROM cohort c

retention_status AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.id_bioguide,
        cr.year_num,
        cr.check_date,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legislators_terms lt

              AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cr.check_date 
              AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= cr.check_date
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM check_retention cr
)

-- Final query: For male legislators from Louisiana, how many distinct legislators were

-- more than 30 and less than 50, grouped by the exact number of years elapsed.
WITH male_la_legislators AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        MIN(lt.term_start)::DATE as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.state = 'LA' AND l.gender = 'M'
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide
),
legislator_dec31 AS (
    SELECT 
        mll.id_bioguide,
        mll.first_term_start,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mll.first_term_start)::INTEGER + 31) as year_lower,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mll.first_term_start) + 49) as year_upper
    FROM male_la_legislators mll
),
year_series AS (
    SELECT 
        ldc.id_bioguide,
        ldc.first_term_start,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ldc.first_term_start)::INTEGER + 31) + (n - 1) as year_val
    FROM legislator_dec31 ldc
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generate_series(1, 19)) AS t(n)
),
serving_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ys.id_bioguide,
        ys.year_val,
        ys.year_val - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ys.first_term_start)::INTEGER as years_elapsed,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = ys.id_bioguide
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= (ys.year_val || '-12-31')::DATE
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= (ys.year_val || '-12-31')::DATE
        ) as was_serving
    FROM year_series ys
)

FROM serving_check
WHERE was_serving = true
GROUP BY years_elapsed

    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feb_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mar_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE 1.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) 
             / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
    END AS pct_increase
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN hubs h ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE o.order_created_month IN (2, 3) AND o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING pct_increase > 20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

WITH batsmen AS (

    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.striker
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, b.striker ASC) <= 3
),
bowlers AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, b.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bowler ASC) as rank
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.bowler
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bowler ASC) <= 3
)

       batsmen.rank as position,
       batsmen.player_id as batsman_id,

       bowlers.player_id as bowler_id,

FROM batsmen

WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no,
        b.striker, b.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as batsman_runs,
        COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as extra_runs,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT *,
        LAG(striker) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as prev_striker,
        LAG(non_striker) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as prev_non_striker
    FROM ball_data
),
with_partner_flag AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_striker IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN (LEAST(striker, non_striker) = LEAST(prev_striker, prev_non_striker) AND GREATEST(striker, non_striker) = GREATEST(prev_striker, prev_non_striker)) THEN 0
            ELSE 1
        END as new_partnership
    FROM with_prev
),
partnership_ids AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(new_partnership) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as partnership_id
    FROM with_partner_flag
),
partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id, innings_no, partnership_id,
        LEAST(striker, non_striker) as bat1,
        GREATEST(striker, non_striker) as bat2,
        SUM(total_runs) as partnership_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = LEAST(striker, non_striker) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) as bat1_batsman_runs,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker = GREATEST(striker, non_striker) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) as bat2_batsman_runs
    FROM partnership_ids
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, partnership_id, LEAST(striker, non_striker), GREATEST(striker, non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_partnerships AS (
    SELECT p.match_id, p.bat1, p.bat2, p.partnership_runs, p.bat1_batsman_runs, p.bat2_batsman_runs
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1 ELSE bat2 END
        END as player1,
        CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2 ELSE bat1 END
        END as player2,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1_batsman_runs
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2_batsman_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat1_batsman_runs ELSE bat2_batsman_runs END
        END AS INTEGER) as player1_score,
        CAST(CASE 
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs > bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat2_batsman_runs
            WHEN bat1_batsman_runs < bat2_batsman_runs THEN bat1_batsman_runs
            ELSE CASE WHEN bat1 > bat2 THEN bat2_batsman_runs ELSE bat1_batsman_runs END
        END AS INTEGER) as player2_score,
        CAST(partnership_runs AS INTEGER) as partnership_runs
    FROM top_partnerships
)
SELECT * FROM ordered
ORDER BY match_id

            WHEN Salary LIKE '%/mo' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(Salary, '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/mo', '') AS DOUBLE) * 12

WITH cond_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        COUNT(*) as condition_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            name, version, step,
            MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as stack_score,
            MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) as max_nonstack_score
        FROM model_score
        WHERE step IN (1, 2, 3)
        GROUP BY name, version, step
        HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) IS NOT NULL
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN model != 'Stack' THEN test_score END) IS NOT NULL
    ) sub
    WHERE max_nonstack_score < stack_score
    GROUP BY name
),
sol_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        COUNT(*) as solution_count
    FROM solution
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT 
    p.name,
    COALESCE(c.condition_count, 0) as condition_count,
    COALESCE(s.solution_count, 0) as solution_count,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.condition_count, 0) > COALESCE(s.solution_count, 0) THEN 'EXCEEDS' ELSE 'no' END as exceeds
FROM problem p
LEFT JOIN cond_counts c ON p.name = c.name
LEFT JOIN sol_counts s ON p.name = s.name
ORDER BY p.name

  FROM model_score

),
non_stack_max AS (

  FROM model_score
  WHERE model != 'Stack'
  GROUP BY name, version, step
),
step_status AS (

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id as root_id,
        pr.packaging_id as current_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pr.qty as level_qty,
        pr.qty as cumulative_qty,
        1 as depth
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pt.contains_id as current_id,
        pr2.contains_id,
        pr2.qty,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr2.qty,
        pt.depth + 1
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr2 ON pt.contains_id = pr2.packaging_id
),
root_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(cumulative_qty) as total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE contains_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM root_totals;

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS qty_at_level,
        1 AS depth,
        CAST(pr.qty AS BIGINT) AS accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT p.id FROM packaging p 
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        ph.top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS qty_at_level,
        ph.depth + 1,
        ph.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = ph.current_id
),
leaf_items AS (
    SELECT id FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.top_id,
        p_leaf.name AS item_name,
        CAST(SUM(ph.accumulated_qty) AS INTEGER) AS total_qty
    FROM packaging_hierarchy ph
    JOIN leaf_items li ON li.id = ph.current_id
    JOIN packaging p_leaf ON p_leaf.id = li.id
    GROUP BY ph.top_id, p_leaf.name
)
SELECT 
    p_top.name AS container_name,
    t.item_name,
    t.total_qty
FROM totals t
JOIN packaging p_top ON p_top.id = t.top_id
WHERE t.total_qty > 500
ORDER BY p_top.name, t.item_name

    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id

cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.*,
        SUM(inv.available_qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY inv.product_id 
            ORDER BY inv.purchased ASC, inv.available_qty ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_total
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
),
needed AS (
    SELECT 
        c.*,
        ol.total_qty AS needed_qty,
        LAG(c.running_total) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.product_id 
            ORDER BY c.purchased ASC, c.available_qty ASC
        ) AS prev_running_total
    FROM cumulative c
    JOIN order_lines ol ON c.product_id = ol.product_id
)

    CASE 
        WHEN prev_running_total IS NULL THEN LEAST(available_qty, needed_qty)
        WHEN running_total <= needed_qty THEN available_qty
        WHEN running_total - available_qty < needed_qty THEN needed_qty - prev_running_total
        ELSE 0
    END AS pick_qty

        WHEN prev_running_total IS NULL THEN LEAST(available_qty, needed_qty)
        WHEN running_total <= needed_qty THEN available_qty

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as time_step,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) as month_of_year
    FROM monthly_sales
    WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        s.product_id,
        s.mth,
        s.qty,
        s.time_step,
        s.month_of_year,
        (AVG(s2.qty) + AVG(s3.qty)) / 2.0 as cma
    FROM sales s
    LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON s.product_id = s2.product_id 
        AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s.time_step - 5 AND s.time_step + 6
    LEFT JOIN sales s3 ON s.product_id = s3.product_id 
        AND s3.time_step BETWEEN s.time_step - 6 AND s.time_step + 5
    WHERE s.time_step BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step, s.month_of_year
),
ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        qty,
        time_step,
        month_of_year,
        cma,
        qty * 1.0 / cma as sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_calc
),
seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) as raw_seasonality
    FROM ratio
    GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
normalized_seasonality AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        month_of_year,
        raw_seasonality / AVG(raw_seasonality) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) as seasonality_factor
    FROM seasonality
),
deseasonalized AS (
    SELECT 
        s.product_id,
        s.time_step,
        s.month_of_year,
        s.qty,
        ns.seasonality_factor,
        CASE WHEN ns.seasonality_factor > 0 THEN s.qty * 1.0 / ns.seasonality_factor ELSE NULL END as deseasonalized_qty
    FROM sales s
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON s.product_id = ns.product_id AND s.month_of_year = ns.month_of_year
),
weighted_reg AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(time_step) as sum_w,
        SUM(time_step * time_step) as sum_wx,
        SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wy,
        SUM(time_step * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) as sum_wxy
    FROM deseasonalized
    WHERE deseasonalized_qty IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
regression AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) as slope,
        (sum_wy - (sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy / sum_w) / (sum_wx - sum_wx * sum_wx / sum_w) * sum_wx) / sum_w as intercept
    FROM weighted_reg
),
forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        r.product_id,
        ns.month_of_year,
        ns.seasonality_factor,
        (r.intercept + r.slope * (37 + ns.month_of_year - 1)) * ns.seasonality_factor as forecast_sales
    FROM regression r
    JOIN normalized_seasonality ns ON r.product_id = ns.product_id
),
annual_forecast AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        SUM(forecast_sales) as annual_forecast
    FROM forecast
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT

    ROUND(annual_forecast, 2) as annual_forecast
FROM annual_forecast
ORDER BY product_id

UNION ALL SELECT * FROM demo_pct
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ctype_pct

SELECT c.name as constructor_name, cy.year, cy.combined
FROM (
    SELECT fc.constructor_id, fc.year, fc.constructor_points, bd.best_driver_points, 
           fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fc.constructor_points + bd.best_driver_points DESC) as rn
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.constructor_id, lr.year, cs.points as constructor_points
        FROM constructor_standings cs
        JOIN (SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id FROM races GROUP BY year) lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
    ) fc
    JOIN (
        SELECT drv_constructor_id as constructor_id, year, MAX(driver_points) as best_driver_points

            JOIN (SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id FROM races GROUP BY year) lr ON ds.race_id = lr.last_race_id
            JOIN drives d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id AND lr.year = d.year
        )
        GROUP BY drv_constructor_id, year
    ) bd ON fc.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id AND fc.year = bd.year

JOIN constructors c ON cy.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE cy.rn <= 3
ORDER BY cy.combined DESC

WITH hiatuses AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, first_round as hiatus_first, last_round as hiatus_last,
           (last_round - first_round + 1) as races_missed
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id = -1
),
all_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as rn
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
hiatus_ranks AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, h.races_missed, h.hiatus_first, h.hiatus_last,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.year, h.driver_id ORDER BY h.hiatus_first) as hrn
    FROM hiatuses h
),
prev_drives AS (
    SELECT h.hrn, a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id, a.last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.year, h.driver_id, h.hrn ORDER BY a.last_round DESC) as rn
    FROM all_drives a
    JOIN hiatus_ranks h ON a.year = h.year AND a.driver_id = h.driver_id
    WHERE a.last_round < h.hiatus_first
),
next_drives AS (
    SELECT h.hrn, a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id, a.first_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.year, h.driver_id, h.hrn ORDER BY a.first_round ASC) as rn
    FROM all_drives a
    JOIN hiatus_ranks h ON a.year = h.year AND a.driver_id = h.driver_id
    WHERE a.first_round > h.hiatus_last
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT h.year, h.driver_id, h.races_missed, h.hiatus_first, h.hiatus_last,
           p.constructor_id as prev_constructor, n.constructor_id as next_constructor
    FROM hiatus_ranks h
    LEFT JOIN prev_drives p ON h.year = p.year AND h.driver_id = p.driver_id AND h.hrn = p.hrn AND p.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN next_drives n ON h.year = n.year AND h.driver_id = n.driver_id AND h.hrn = n.hrn AND n.rn = 1
    WHERE p.constructor_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND n.constructor_id IS NOT NULL
      AND p.constructor_id != n.constructor_id
      AND h.races_missed < 3
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * hiatus_first) as avg_first_round,
    AVG(1.0 * hiatus_last) as avg_last_round
FROM qualifying

WITH race_laps AS (
    SELECT 
        race_id, driver_id, lap, position,
        LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) as prev_position
    FROM lap_positions 
    WHERE lap_type = 'Race' AND lap > 1
),
pit_affected AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap as affected_lap
    FROM pit_stops
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap + 1 as affected_lap
    FROM pit_stops
),
position_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        rl.race_id, rl.driver_id, rl.lap, rl.position, rl.prev_position,
        rl.position - rl.prev_position as pos_change
    FROM race_laps rl
    LEFT JOIN pit_affected pa ON rl.race_id = pa.race_id AND rl.driver_id = pa.driver_id AND rl.lap = pa.affected_lap
    WHERE pa.affected_lap IS NULL
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*) as overtakes_count
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE pos_change < 0
    GROUP BY driver_id
),
being_overtaken AS (
    SELECT driver_id, COUNT(*) as being_overtaken_count
    FROM position_changes
    WHERE pos_change > 0
    GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT 
    d.driver_id,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    COALESCE(o.overtakes_count, 0) as overtakes_count,
    COALESCE(bo.being_overtaken_count, 0) as being_overtaken_count
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN overtakes o ON d.driver_id = o.driver_id
LEFT JOIN being_overtaken bo ON d.driver_id = bo.driver_id
WHERE COALESCE(bo.being_overtaken_count, 0) > COALESCE(o.overtakes_count, 0)
